balance.title: Your balance and cashflow
balance.body: Balance changes from sponsor (income at season start), salaries (paid at the start of the next season after sponsor lands), transfers, and prize money (ongoing). Red numbers mean negative balance, and the emergency-loan mechanism kicks in at the next season start if sponsor and balance cannot cover salary and interest.

debtCeiling.title: Debt cap per division
debtCeiling.body: Each division has a cap on total debt (D1 1,200K · D2 900K · D3 600K). Once the cap is reached, new loans are blocked, and the board also penalises overspending at season evaluation.

txHistory.title: Follow the cashflow
txHistory.body: Sponsor and salary are one-off per season (both at season start: sponsor first, then salary), while prize money and transfers come in continuously. Here you see every transaction, use it to track whether the finances are heading the right way.

hint.title: How your finances work
hint.subtitle: Four income and expense streams drive your balance. Understand them, and you can prioritise sport, growth, and debt.

sponsor.title: Sponsor income
sponsor.before: Scaled by division (D1 600,000 · D2 400,000 · D3 340,000 CZ$) per season × your
sponsor.after: . Paid as a lump sum at season start.

salary.title: Rider salaries
salary.body: A rider's wage is the price of what he delivers this season, not what he is worth on the market. It is a fixed share of his current production value, the same share for every team in every division, so a better rider always costs more. Wages are frozen when you sign or extend, so a rider's wage does not move with his market value afterwards. Deducted as a lump sum at the start of the next season, right after the sponsor lands.

debt.title: Debt cap per division
debt.body: D1 1,200K · D2 900K · D3 600K. Break the cap and new loans are blocked, and the board punishes overspending.

loans.title: Loans, short vs long
loans.body: Short loan: low fee, fast repayment. Long loan: larger amount across several seasons. Use them for transfer peaks, not operating gaps.

receipt.title: Season {current} → {next} settlement
receipt.subtitle: What happens to your balance when the books close and season {next} starts, in the same order the game actually charges it.

books_close.label: Books close
books_close.detail: Your balance as it stands right now, carried into the switch.

sponsor.label: Sponsor lands
sponsor.detail: Base {base} + performance bonus {variable} from last season's rank/points, credited together as one payment at season start.

loan_interest.label: Loan interest
loan_interest.detail: Interest on your active loans' outstanding debt, calculated right after the sponsor payment lands. Added to the loan itself, not deducted from your balance.

salary.label: Salaries for season {next} are charged
salary.detail: Recomputed under the season {next} rules from each rider's current production value on the day of the switch, not last season's frozen contract numbers.

upkeep.label: Division upkeep
upkeep.detail: Flat cost set by your division, charged at season start.

staff_salary.label: Staff salaries

seasonSwitch.footnote: Settlement preview, not a guarantee. Prize money and per-stage sponsor income aren't included, since they depend on races not yet run, and neither is anything contingent, like emergency-loan interest if your balance goes negative, or a forced sale if your debt breaks the cap. Scout travel, transfers, facility purchases, staff changes, and academy signings aren't included either, since none of it is known ahead of time.
